Short, bob-cut hair in a pale lavender shade with straight bangs. Wide, curious eyes in a soft violet shade. Apparent age of a young teenager with a soft, rounded face. Small, slender build. A white and blue sailor-style school uniform with a short pleated skirt and a red necktie. Small, rounded white animal ears atop the head and a short, fluffy white tail.
BODY COLOR: pale peach
